pages.title: Bar Harbor
pages.description: town in Hancock County, Maine, United States
pages.extract: Bar Harbor is a village on Mount Desert Island in Hancock County in the Down East area of Maine.  It is a useful base for those visiting Acadia National Park.

pages.title: Carvoeiro
pages.description: former civil parish in Lagoa, Portugal
pages.extract: Carvoeiro is a village in Algarve. Carvoeiro, or more commonly known as Praia de Carvoeiro (although this is no longer its formal name), is a Portuguese civil parish/freguesia in the municipality/concelho of Lagoa (Algarve), about 5 km south of the city (on the Atlantic Ocean). This picturesque fishing village, with a long history of settlement, has grown over the last decades into the main tourist area of the concelho. It has a number of fine beaches protected by cliffs.

pages.title: Karoo National Park
pages.extract: The Karoo National Park is just west of Beaufort West in South Africa. This semi-desert area covers an area of 750 km² (290 sq mi). It is a sanctuary for herds of springbok, Oryx, zebra, buffalo, hartebeest, rhinoceros, eland, kudu, klipspringer, bat-eared foxes, black-backed jackal, ostriches, and lions. It also has the greatest number of tortoise species of any park in the world - five in total.

pages.title: Leduc
pages.extract: Leduc is a city in Edmonton Capital Region.  It has a population of 34,000 people (2021).  It is known for its industry and the Edmonton International Airport.  Leduc County is also home to the Leduc Number 1 Oilwell, which started Alberta's oil boom in 1947.

pages.title: Mamallapuram
pages.description: Village in Kanchipuram District, Tamil Nadu, India
pages.extract: Mamallapuram (மாமல்லபுரம் Māmallaburam), also known as Mahabalipuram, is a tourist town 60 km south of Chennai on the east coast of India, famous for its stone carvings.

pages.extract: Mühlhausen is a city in Thuringia.

pages.title: Ngari (prefecture)
pages.description: prefecture in China's Tibet Autonomous Region
pages.extract: Ngari prefecture (also known as Ali prefecture 阿里地区 Ālǐ Dìqū) is in the far west of Tibet. It is located in the northern Tibetan Plateau and has the most unique natural scenery in Tibet. It is also one of the areas with the lowest population density.

pages.title: Bouillon
pages.extract: Bouillon is a small town located on the southern edge of the province of Luxembourg in the Wallonia region in Belgium. The Semois river cut out the beautiful valley in which the town was built. The town is located merely 2 kilometers from the border with France.

pages.title: Malolos
pages.description: city of the Philippines and capital of the province of Bulacan
pages.extract: Malolos is a city in the province of Bulacan, Philippines. It is the capital of Bulacan and occupies a special place in Philippine history as the capital of an independent Philippines in between the Spanish and American occupations.

pages.title: Kogi State
pages.extract: Kogi State is a state in North Central Nigeria. The state is nicknamed the "Confluence State" due the fact that the confluence of the River Niger and the River Benue occurs next to its capital, Lokoja.
